SELECT id, job_name, job_group, job_class, invoke_target, cron_expression, misfire_policy, concurrent, job_params, start_time, end_time, status, remark, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user FROM sys_job
AND job_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.jobName}, '%')
AND job_group LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.jobGroup}, '%')
AND status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
